AUS.note: World's top barley exporter MY2024/25; ~8.0 Mt exports (USDA FAS PSD). Regained #1 to China after May 2023 removal of Chinese anti-dumping/countervailing duties.

FRA.note: EU's largest barley producer/exporter; major malting and feed barley to China, Belgium/Netherlands, North Africa. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

RUS.note: Top-3 barley exporter; key feed-barley supplier to Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Turkey, Iran, North Africa. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

UKR.note: Significant barley exporter to China, Saudi Arabia, Jordan and the EU despite war-related logistics constraints. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

ARG.note: Leading Southern-Hemisphere barley exporter alongside Australia; malting and feed shipments to China, Brazil, Saudi Arabia. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

CAN.note: Exports feed and malting barley primarily to China, Japan, the USA. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

DEU.note: Top EU producer; large intra-EU re-export hub flows to Netherlands/Belgium plus North Africa and Saudi Arabia. USDA FAS PSD/Eurostat MY2024/25.

KAZ.note: Supplies feed barley to China, Iran and Central Asia. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

ROU.note: Black Sea EU exporter shipping barley to Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Morocco and the wider Middle East/North Africa. USDA FAS PSD/Eurostat MY2024/25.

DNK.note: Exports malting and feed barley within the EU. USDA FAS PSD/Eurostat MY2024/25.

CHN.note: World's #1 barley importer (feed + malting). 2024 imports ~14.2 Mt rebounded after the May 2023 end of tariffs on Australian barley restored Australia as top supplier. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024 (importer-reported).

SAU.note: Leading feed-barley importer; 2024 imports ~3.66 Mt led by Russia, Argentina, Ukraine. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024.

MAR.note: Imports barley for feed during recurrent drought years; 2024 imports ~1.15 Mt from the EU (Germany, France, Romania) and Russia. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024.

JPN.note: Imports feed and food/malting barley mainly from Australia and Canada; 2024 imports ~1.17 Mt. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024.

JOR.note: Near-total importer of feed barley; 2024 imports ~0.76 Mt from Romania, Russia, Ukraine. WITS/UN Comtrade 2024.

IRN.note: Major feed-barley importer but does not report to Comtrade; figure is an exporter-mirror/USDA estimate (~3 Mt from Russia, Kazakhstan, the EU). Modeled.

TUR.note: Imports feed barley in drought years; 2024 figure ~0.75 Mt is mirror-estimated (Comtrade preview returned an estimated/legacy block) from Russia, Ukraine, Bulgaria, Romania. Modeled.

TUN.note: Imports feed/food barley; 2024 figure ~0.75 Mt is mirror-estimated from France, Russia, Ukraine, Black Sea. Modeled.

rankings.note: Exporter totals are USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25; importer totals are UN Comtrade/WITS 2024 importer-reported (Iran, Tunisia, Turkiye are mirror/estimated). companies.name: Cargill
companies.metric: Revenue ~US$160bn (FY2024, private); one of the 'ABCD' grain majors.
companies.note: Global grain merchant trading barley (feed and malting) across the Black Sea, EU, Australia and the Americas; integrated origination, storage and shipping.
companies.improve: Should disclose barley-specific volumes; figures are firm-wide and barley is a minor line within its grains & oilseeds platform.

companies.name: Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM)
companies.note: Originates and trades barley and other grains globally; one of the 'ABCD' majors.
companies.improve: Should report barley-only tonnage; barley is embedded in its Ag Services & Oilseeds segment.

companies.name: Louis Dreyfus Company
companies.note: Major merchant of grains incl. barley across the Black Sea, EU, Australia and South America; strong Black Sea origination.
companies.improve: Should disclose barley volumes; reported within its Grains & Oilseeds platform.

companies.name: Viterra
companies.note: Leading barley exporter from Australia and Canada; benefited directly from the 2023 reopening of the Chinese market.
companies.improve: Post-Bunge merger, standalone barley tonnage is no longer separately published.

companies.name: COFCO International
companies.note: Trading arm of China's state agribusiness; a key channel for China's record barley imports. Central to China's grain-security strategy.
companies.improve: Should itemize barley-specific volumes; disclosure is at commodity-group level.

companies.name: GrainCorp
companies.note: Australia's largest east-coast grain handler and a major barley exporter; benefited directly from the 2023 reopening of the Chinese market.
companies.improve: Should report barley-only tonnage rather than total grain volumes handled.

global.note: Global barley, kt, USDA FAS PSD marketing-year series. Production dipped in MY2022/23 and MY2023/24 on EU and Australian weather variability; world trade is dominated by feed barley to China and the Middle East.
